subtitle: Develop precision, speed, and expression through systematic technique practice
heroDescription: Build the foundation for expressive playing through systematic development of essential guitar techniques. From basic picking patterns to advanced two-handed tapping, develop the skills that will unlock your musical potential.

items.title: Precision & Control
items.description: Develop the accuracy and consistency needed to execute complex musical ideas cleanly and reliably.

items.title: Speed & Fluidity
items.description: Build the physical foundation to play at any tempo while maintaining musical expression and clarity.

items.title: Expression & Style
items.description: Unlock advanced techniques that allow you to express complex musical ideas and develop your unique voice.

progressiveSteps.title: Foundation Techniques
progressiveSteps.description: Start with alternate picking, palm muting, and basic bending for solid fundamentals.

progressiveSteps.title: Intermediate Skills
progressiveSteps.description: Progress to legato, hybrid picking, and string skipping for expanded vocabulary.

progressiveSteps.title: Advanced Mastery
progressiveSteps.description: Master sweep picking and tapping for virtuosic expression and technical excellence.

itemTypes.name: Alternate Picking
itemTypes.description: Master precision and speed with alternating up and down strokes.

itemTypes.name: Legato
itemTypes.description: Create smooth, flowing lines with hammer-ons, pull-offs, and slides.

itemTypes.name: Sweep Picking
itemTypes.description: Execute lightning-fast arpeggios with fluid sweeping motions.

itemTypes.name: String Skipping
itemTypes.description: Create wide intervallic lines by jumping across non-adjacent strings.

itemTypes.name: Bending & Vibrato
itemTypes.description: Add soul and expression through controlled pitch bending and vibrato.

itemTypes.name: Tapping
itemTypes.description: Utilize both hands for spectacular runs and impossible intervals.

itemTypes.name: Palm Muting
itemTypes.description: Control dynamics and create punchy, percussive tones.

itemTypes.name: Hybrid Picking
itemTypes.description: Combine pick and fingers for complex rhythms and textures.

itemTypes.name: Slides & Glissando
itemTypes.description: Add smooth, expressive transitions between notes with slides.

itemTypes.name: Harmonics
itemTypes.description: Produce bell-like tones with natural and artificial harmonics.

bestPractices.title: Best Practices
items: Start slowly and focus on perfect execution
Use a metronome to develop timing and consistency
Practice in short, focused sessions (15-30 minutes)
Gradually increase tempo while maintaining accuracy
Record yourself to identify areas for improvement

commonMistakes.title: Common Mistakes
items: Playing too fast before mastering slow execution
Ignoring proper hand position and posture
Neglecting to warm up before intense practice
Focusing only on speed without musical application

famousPlayers.title: Masters of Technique
famousPlayers.description: Study these guitarists who have pushed the boundaries of what's possible on the instrument through dedicated technique development.

journeySection.title: Ready to Begin?
journeySection.description: Start with the fundamentals and work your way up. Remember: consistent, focused practice is more valuable than speed. Choose a technique that matches your current level and commit to daily practice.
